description: Diagnostic-only exact post-head probability, coder-state, transformed-stream, and complete 26-range semantic FXCM state observer for the frozen opening-100M parent/q1 identity gate.
hypothesis: The q1 allocation/residency mutation preserves every final integer probability, arithmetic-coder checkpoint, payload byte, transformed inverse byte, and source-ordered semantic byte in all 26 directly affected large FXCM ranges on canonical opening 100M.
claim_boundary: Observer source and exact patch application only. No execution result, q1 qualification, compression improvement, authorship credit, score credit, runtime authority, or release-memory authority.
invariants: The observer is compiled into matched parent and q1 diagnostic arms from the same sealed source closure.
Only q1 allocation backing differs between diagnostic arms.
Final uint16 probabilities are hashed little-endian after KhBitLstm32Head::Adjust and immediately before the arithmetic split.
State hashes include ordinal, requested semantic bytes, alignment, and exactly the semantic allocation bytes; allocator padding and residency metadata are excluded.
The release-memory arm remains the observer-free sealed q1 build.
A result cannot execute while an exclusive full-1G lease or its acquisition lock is active.

state_mutation_control.required_effect: The one-byte mutation must change the ordinal-zero range SHA-256 and the aggregate checkpoint SHA-256; the unchanged terminal snapshot must then equal the mutation snapshot.

controls_required_before_100m: observer-off versus observer-on payload and inverse identity on opening 10M
online probability digest reproduces the retained opening 10M post-head digest
online probability digest reproduces the retained distant 10M post-head digest
pre-head negative control differs while payload stays unchanged
one copied-state byte mutation changes both its range digest and checkpoint aggregate
two independently built observer binaries are byte-identical within arm
